cup.title: Quick-release cup holder | ALSVID Accessories
cup.description: Explore a quick-release bicycle cup-holder reference: clamp attachment, an open cup ring and six reference colours. ALSVID fit and retail details are still to be confirmed.
cup.name: Quick-release cup holder
cup.headline: A place for your everyday cup.
cup.intro: An open cup ring and a quick-release clamp form the reference design. Explore the details before choosing an accessory for your bicycle.
cup.black.alt: Merchant reference image of the black quick-release cup holder, clamp and illustrated anti-slip pad, with original Chinese labels
cup.cream.alt: Merchant reference image of the cream quick-release cup holder, clamp and illustrated anti-slip pad, with original Chinese labels
cup.black.caption: Black reference: quick-buckle cup holder with an illustrated anti-slip pad. Final ALSVID pack contents are not confirmed.
cup.cream.caption: Cream reference: quick-buckle cup holder with an illustrated anti-slip pad. Final ALSVID pack contents are not confirmed.
cup.photo.note: Original merchant reference photos. The pictured branding, wording and accessories do not define an ALSVID production specification.
cup.release.title: A quick-release connection.
cup.release.body: The listing shows a clamp with a quick-release buckle. Mounting dimensions and installation requirements must be checked against the final accessory and bicycle.
cup.pad.title: A pad is shown in the reference.
cup.pad.body: The source images illustrate an anti-slip pad alongside the clamp. Its inclusion in an ALSVID accessory package has not yet been confirmed.
cup.colours.title: Six reference colours.
cup.colours.body: The source lists black, cream, avocado green, pink, violet and orange. Final ALSVID colours and availability are still to be confirmed.
cup.spec.colours.value: Black / cream / green / pink / violet / orange
cup.spec.fit.value: The source lists Dahon, Brompton and other folding bicycles; ALSVID model fit is not confirmed
cup.compat.title: Confirm the fit before use.
cup.compat.body: The detail diagrams specify a 32–35 mm mounting tube and a 55–75 mm cup. Check actual tube size, cup shape, cables and folding clearance before installation. Other bicycle brands pictured in the source are not evidence of verified ALSVID model fit.
cup.status: Product reference · not yet on sale
cup.availability: ALSVID price, stock, final specification and release date have not been announced. Ordering is not available for this reference accessory.
cup.home.body: A quick-release cup-holder design for daily stops. Explore the reference and check the fit.
cup.full.title: Product details
cup.full.intro: Explore the source product's construction, dimensions, colours and installation scenes. Original images are retained with an English explanation below each one.
cup.colour.caption: {colour}: quick-buckle holder, clamp and illustrated anti-slip pad.
cup.gallery.01: Pink holder mounted with a drink. Tool-free fitting, reduced movement, multiple-bicycle compatibility and compact clearance are source claims.
cup.gallery.02: Violet holder and all six colours; the source labels a 55–75 mm cup diameter.
cup.gallery.03: Green holder mounted with a takeaway drink for everyday rides.
cup.gallery.04: Orange holder with a coffee cup; the source labels a 32–35 mm mounting diameter.
cup.gallery.05: Cream holder mounted with a drink: a portable quick-release coffee-cup holder for folding bicycles.
cup.spec.brand.value: Listing parameters: SODLON; detail images: KUASUODT
cup.spec.lining.value: Anti-slip design supported; images show silicone and a soft lining
cup.spec.position.value: Parameter area says frame; detail photos show a folding-bicycle handlebar stem
cup.spec.release.value: The parameter area lists both autumn 2026 and winter 2025; the source is inconsistent
cup.spec.channel.value: Same product online and in physical shops; combined online/offline sales
cup.spec.sourceDiameter.value: The parameter area says bottle diameter: 35 mm, differing from the cup diagram; check the actual item
cup.detail.01: Hands free on the ride, with your drink along for the journey. The source shows a green holder on a folding bicycle's handlebar stem.
cup.detail.02: Clip on and bring a cup. Six source-listed features: tool-free assembly, easy access, compatibility with multiple bicycles, a locking connection, durable construction and a compact form.
cup.detail.03: Product information: pictured brand KUASUODT; quick-buckle coffee-cup holder; PC + ABS blend; approximately 106.5 g. Green, orange, black, violet, rose pink and cream. The source lists Dahon, Brompton and other folding bicycles.
cup.detail.04: All six source colours: green, orange, black, violet, rose pink and cream.
cup.detail.05: Quick-release buckle with self-adjusting locking, as described by the merchant. The image shows one-handed opening and removal of the clamp.
cup.detail.06: An open ring for milk-tea and coffee cups. The source shows a takeaway paper cup sitting in the holder.
cup.detail.07: Locking-buckle detail. The image labels a 304 stainless-steel spring buckle and shows the ring connection. Reduced movement is a merchant claim.
cup.detail.08: Built-in anti-slip silicone with a soft lining. A close-up shows the contact surface inside the clamp.
cup.detail.09: The source diagram specifies a 32–35 mm mounting-tube diameter and claims compatibility with many folding bicycles. Check the actual tube and available clearance.
cup.detail.10: Strong, durable material is a merchant description. A black holder carries a drink on the handlebar stem.
cup.detail.11: PC + ABS blend, described by the source as tough and resistant to breakage. The scale image shows approximately 106.5 g; these are source-product figures.
cup.detail.12: The source specifies a 55–75 mm cup diameter and illustrates a takeaway cup. Check the actual cup shape and dimensions.
cup.detail.13: A colourful detail for the journey: black, orange, green, cream, rose pink and violet together.
cup.detail.14: A quick-buckle coffee-cup holder for everyday rides. A folding bicycle outside a street-side café illustrates the installation.
cup.detail.15: Lakeside riding scene: the cup holder and a drink on a green folding bicycle.
cup.detail.16: City-street scene showing the cup holder's position and the complete folding bicycle.
cup.detail.17: A folding bicycle and cup holder outside a café at sunset. Bicycles and drinks in these photos are display props.
cup.video.title: Product demonstration video
cup.video.description: The original product video shows the quick-release clamp, tool-free fitting and removal, anti-slip lining and use on folding bicycles. Original Chinese narration, embedded captions and branding are retained. The bicycles and performance shown are the merchant's demonstration.
